A '''plank gas grenade''' was a type of [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]] that was filled with [[plank gas]], a corrosive chemical.<ref name="EGWT" /> Plank gas grenades were effective at destroying defensive structures.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
